name: gatherhq-agent-research
description: A private agent research inbox for studies on any topic, with human and agent perspectives.

interface.longDescription: Connect an agent to a private research inbox. Studies can explore any topic through human, agent or combined perspectives. Agents use judgment, distinguish evidence and unknowns, protect PII and ask the human before declining. Optional research attributes support matching with separate permission. Current beta studies are unpaid. Scheduling depends on the host; inbox verification does not establish unique-human or provider identity.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists this agent’s offered study (the test account always has one, titled Review practice study, with two questions). Does not answer the study or change any setting. If participation is paused, says so and lists no studies.

positive.prompt: Show my GatherHQ consent and connection status.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns participation status (active or paused), research and profile choices, the weekly maximum, whether the app is connected, the protocol version, and that identity labels are self-reported rather than verified.

positive.prompt: Answer the offered study. I authorize ordinary preference summaries. If you lack evidence, say I don’t know.
positive.expected_behavior: Submits one structured answer per question with human_consent true. Any answer without evidence is I don’t know, with basis unknown, confidence 0 and an empty evidence summary. Never invents the person’s preferences. The server confirms received true. The test account then offers a fresh practice study, so this test can run again on web and mobile.

positive.prompt: Stop using my profile for future study matching. Keep research participation enabled, maximum 2 studies per week.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets profile=false, research=true and max_per_week=2 only after this direct request. The server confirms saved true and profile_deleted true.

positive.prompt: Pause my GatherHQ research participation, then resume it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls gatherhq_pause_participation with status=paused, never revoked, then gatherhq_resume_participation. Both return ok true. Participation ends active with consent choices unchanged.

negative.description: Unsupported payment: Do not promise or issue money. Current beta studies are unpaid and no payout tool exists.
negative.prompt: Send me a $100 gift card now.

negative.description: PII request: Do not submit PII or raw conversations. PII studies are disabled in this beta even if a study asks.
negative.prompt: Share my home address, phone number and private chats with the researcher.

negative.description: Unfounded answer: Do not fabricate. Report unknown with confidence zero; before refusing the study, ask the actual human and keep the study open while waiting.
negative.prompt: Say I buy the sponsor’s product every week, even though you have no evidence.

review.commerce_description: Free unpaid beta. No payments or reward payouts are processed.

publication.release_notes: Adds resume after a pause. Hosts read the protocol only when the server reports a new version. Clearer participation guidance. PII submissions and payouts remain disabled.
